responsibility: Implements the generic device callback container used throughout the gm2 ISO I/O runtime. It allocates a GenDevIF record holding a DeviceId and procedure pointers for primitive read, write, line, errno, and status operations, and provides thin dispatch wrappers and destruction; this module therefore supplies the concrete function-table object that RTgen-based devices install and invoke.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements the GenDevIF callback container by defining the record that stores DeviceId and procedure pointers and by providing the thin wrapper calls. In contrast, RTgenif.def only exposes the opaque type, callback signatures, and exported entry points used by device modules and RTgen.
